entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, you can't dig around in the fridge while[n]the shop's open.
entries.uk: Гей, не можна нишпорити в холодильнику,[n]поки кав'ярня відчинена.

entries.en: Sojiro's got an eye on me...
entries.uk: Соджіро не зводить із мене очей...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, there's [var 0][n]and [var 1] in here!
entries.uk: О, тут є ось що: [var 0],[n]а ще [var 1]!

entries.en: I see [var 0] and[n][var 1] in there...
entries.uk: Бачу, тут є ось що: [var 0],[n]а ще [var 1]...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So, which do you wanna eat?
entries.uk: То що з цього хочеш з'їсти?

entries.en: Which should I eat?
The leftover pilaf...
The leftover omelette rice...
The leftover sandwiches...
The leftover curry...
The deluxe katsu sandwich.
The mille-feuille...
The coffee jelly...
The fish in meuniere sauce...
Never mind.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Wait, there's a sticker that says "Leblanc" on[n]the [var 1].

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Doesn't that mean not to touch it because[n]it's for the cafe?
entries.uk: Це ж, мабуть, означає «не чіпати»,[n]бо воно для кав'ярні?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Though, if someone tells you not to do[n]something, it just makes you want to do[n]it even more...
entries.uk: Хоча коли тобі щось забороняють,[n]цього хочеться ще дужче...

entries.en: There's a Leblanc sticker[n]on the [var 1]...
It looks like this is for the café.[n]Am I allowed to eat this?
entries.uk: Схоже, це для кав'ярні.[n]Чи можна мені це їсти?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The [var 1] has a Leblanc[n]sticker on it...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh wait, there's a note attached to it, too.
entries.uk: О, стривай, тут ще й записка причеплена.

entries.en: The [var 1] has a[n]Leblanc sticker on it.
There's also a note[n]attached to it.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The [var 1] has a[n]Leblanc sticker on it...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Wait, there's no note this time. Did the chief[n]finally give up?
entries.uk: Стривай, цього разу записки немає.[n]Невже шеф нарешті здався?

entries.en: The [var 1] has[n]a Leblanc sticker on it.
But there's no note...[n]Maybe Sojiro gave up.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The [var 1] has a[n]Leblanc sticker on it...
The [var 1] has a[n]Leblanc sticker on it.
Which should I eat?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Wait, aren't you going to eat dinner? It's not[n]good to just skip meals...
entries.uk: Стривай, ти що, не вечерятимеш?[n]Пропускати їжу шкідливо...

entries.en: Maybe I should do something else...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Wait, you're not going to eat it? You've got[n]to have more [stIcon 3][clr 26][stLabel 3][clr 27] than that.
entries.uk: Стривай, ти не їстимеш? Твій показник[n][stIcon 3][clr 26][stLabel 3][clr 27] мав би бути вищим.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So, what do you want to do?
I really don't have the[n][stIcon 3][clr 26][stLabel 3][clr 27] to eat this...
What should I do...?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hehehe! You're starting to have more[n][stIcon 3][clr 26][stLabel 3][clr 27], just like a phantom thief[n]should!
entries.uk: Хе-хе-хе! Твій показник[n][stIcon 3][clr 26][stLabel 3][clr 27] зростає, як і личить[n]Фантомному Злодієві!

entries.en: I might get yelled at later, but...
entries.uk: Потім на мене, мабуть, накричать, але...

entries.speaker: Note from Sojiro
entries.en: "Don't eat the ones[n]with the Leblanc stickers."

entries.speaker: Note from Sojiro
entries.en: "You ate some of the cafe's food again,[n]didn't you? Didn't you notice the Leblanc[n]sticker?"
entries.uk: «Ти знову з'їв їжу для кав'ярні, так?[n]Не помітив наліпки "Леблан"?»

entries.speaker: Note from Sojiro
entries.en: "Don't touch anything that has[n]'LEBLANC' written on it. Got it?"
entries.uk: «Не чіпай нічого, на чому написано[n]"ЛЕБЛАН". Затямив?»

entries.speaker: Note from Sojiro
entries.en: "Hey... Don't eat the cafe's food. If you're[n]hungry, eat what I made you for dinner."
entries.uk: «Гей... Не їж того, що для кав'ярні.[n]Зголоднів — їж вечерю, яку я тобі лишив».

entries.speaker: Note from Sojiro
entries.en: "I did tell you you could eat whatever you[n]want in the fridge, but don't steal the cafe's[n]food."
entries.uk: «Я казав, що можеш брати з холодильника[n]що завгодно, але не цупи їжу кав'ярні».

entries.speaker: Note from Sojiro
entries.en: "You're not in a position where you can[n]just get away with that kind of thing now,[n]are you?"
entries.uk: «Ти ж зараз не в тому становищі,[n]щоб таке сходило тобі з рук, чи не так?»

entries.speaker: Note from Sojiro
entries.en: "You did it again, didn't you? Was it good?"
entries.uk: «Знову за своє, так? Хоч смачно було?»

entries.speaker: Note from Sojiro
entries.en: "The one you ate was actually poisoned.[n]You only have about three days to live."
entries.uk: «Те, що ти з'їв, було отруєне.[n]Жити тобі лишилося дні зо три».

entries.speaker: Note from Sojiro
entries.en: "...Not really, but don't blame me if[n]something happens next time. Stop[n]eating the cafe's food."
entries.uk: «...Жартую, але наступного разу не нарікай,[n]якщо щось станеться. Годі їсти[n]те, що для кав'ярні».

entries.speaker: Note from Sojiro
entries.en: "It's starting to become a hassle to write[n]one of these every time you steal food."
entries.uk: «Мені вже набридає писати записку[n]щоразу, як ти цупиш їжу».

entries.speaker: Note from Sojiro
entries.en: "This is your last warning!"

entries.speaker: Note from Sojiro
entries.en: "I thought last time would be the last one,[n]but I decided to write another one, after all."
entries.uk: «Думав, минулий раз буде останнім,[n]але таки вирішив написати ще одну».

entries.speaker: Note from Sojiro
entries.en: "Once you make it in life, you're gonna pay[n]me back for all the stuff you ate. Got it?"
entries.uk: «Коли виб'єшся в люди, відшкодуєш мені[n]все, що з'їв. Затямив?»

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That's what it says.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But it's in a phantom thief's nature to steal[n]something when it's more difficult to take!
entries.uk: Але ж у природі Фантомного Злодія —[n]красти саме те, що взяти найважче!

entries.en: It looks like I got[n]caught stealing food...
